data.gender_notes: Mildrid is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Mildrid is derived from Old English elements mild, meaning gentle, and hrid, meaning ruler. In medieval England, this name was borne by a few women and is now considered rare. The name was also borne by a saint, Saint Mildred, who was a 7th-century virgin and abbess in England. The name Mildrid carries the meaning “Gentle Ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Mildrid usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A gentle spirit who rules with compassion and grace.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mildrid total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

For those named Mildrid, this name serves as a reminder to embody the calm and gentle strength of Christ in all areas of life.
